Target: NVIDIA (NVDA). NVIDIA designs accelerated computing platforms, GPUs and related software used in data centers, AI, graphics and gaming.

Focal announcement: NVIDIA Launches NVIDIA Halos, a Full-Stack, Comprehensive Safety System for Autonomous Vehicles.

Decision cutoff: 2025-03-18T23:59:59-04:00. Only information available before this cutoff is admissible.

Source: NVIDIA Launches NVIDIA Halos, a Full-Stack, Comprehensive Safety System for Autonomous Vehicles. Published: 2025-03-18. URL: https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/halos-safety-system-autonomous-vehicles.

Condensed source facts; other details are omitted: Editor’s note: The name of NVIDIA DRIVE Hyperion was changed to NVIDIA Hyperion in September 2026. That’s why NVIDIA today announced NVIDIA Halos — a comprehensive safety system bringing together NVIDIA’s lineup of automotive hardware and software safety solutions with its cutting-edge AI research in AV safety. “With the launch of Halos, we’re empowering partners and developers to choose the state-of-the-art technology elements they need to build their own unique offerings, driving forward a shared mission to create safe and reliable autonomous vehicles,” said Riccardo Mariani, vice president of industry safety at NVIDIA. The NVIDIA DriveOS 6.0 operating system conforms with ISO 26262 automotive safety integrity level (ASIL D) standards. To learn more about NVIDIA’s approach to automotive safety, attend AV Safety Day today at NVIDIA GTC, a global AI conference running through Friday, March 21.

The previously fitted market-only reference model favored an upward return beyond the neutral band. Its leading outcome was favored, with meaningful uncertainty. It still assigned meaningful possibility to a return inside the narrow neutral band and a downward return beyond the neutral band. This is a training-only model forecast, not an observed outcome or independent news evidence.

The neutral return band's half-width is much narrower than the code-computed ordinary five-session variability scale. An irrelevant article does not eliminate ordinary price movement; this is not a calculated class probability.
